title: 折叠后用三角形相似求线段长度
stem:
如图，\(\vartriangle ABC\)为等边三角形，点\(D,E\)分别在边\(AB,AC\)上，\(BD=6\)，将\(\vartriangle ADE\)沿直线\(DE\)翻折得到\(\vartriangle FDE\)，当点\(F\)落在边\(BC\)上，且\(BF=4CF\)时，\(DE\cdot AF\)的值为_______．
〔图1〕
given_solution:
【分析】过点\(A,D\)分别作\(AL\bot BC\)，\(DH\bot BC\)于点\(L,H\)，由\(\vartriangle ABC\)为等边三角形与\(\vartriangle ADE\)沿直线\(DE\)翻折得到\(\vartriangle FDE\)，可得\(\vartriangle BDF\backsim \vartriangle CFE,\)设\(CF=x,(x>0),\)\(BF=4CF\)，\(BD=6\)可求得线段\(BF,CE,BC,AD,AE\)通过\(\vartriangle BDF\backsim \vartriangle CFE,\)可求出x的值即可得\(S_{ \vartriangle ABC } ，S_{ \vartriangle BDF } ，S_{ \vartriangle CEF }\)四边形\(ADFE\)的面积\(=S_{ \vartriangle ABC } -S_{ \vartriangle BDF } -S_{ \vartriangle CEF }\)，因为\(DE\bot AF\)所以四边形\(ADFE\)的面积\(=\frac { 1 } { 2 }DE\cdot AF\)由此即可求解．
【详解】如图，过点\(A,D\)分别作\(AL\bot BC\)，\(DH\bot BC\)于点\(L,H\)，如图：
〔图2〕
\(\because \vartriangle ABC\)为等边三角形，\(\vartriangle ADE\)沿直线\(DE\)翻折得到\(\vartriangle FDE\)，
\(\therefore \angle DFE=\angle DAE=60{}^\circ ,AD=DF,\)
\(\therefore \angle CFE+\angle FEC=\angle CFE+\angle DFB\)\(=120{}^\circ\)
\(\therefore \angle DFB=\angle CEF,\)
\(\because \angle B=\angle C=60{}^\circ ,\)
\(\therefore \vartriangle BDF\backsim \vartriangle CFE,\)
\(\therefore \frac { BD } { CF }=\frac { BF } { CE },\)
\(\therefore CE=\frac { BF\cdot CF } { BD },\)
设\(CF=x,(x>0),\)
\(\because BF=4CF,\)
\(\therefore BF=4x,\)
\(\because BD=6,\)
\(\therefore CE=\frac { 4x\cdot x } { 6 }=\frac { 2x ^ { 2 } } { 3 },\)
\(\because BC=BF+CF=4x+x=5x,\)
\(\therefore AD=AB-BD=BC-BD=DF\)\(=5x-6\)
\(AE=EF=AC-CE=5x-\frac { 2x ^ { 2 } } { 3 },\)
\(\because \vartriangle BDF\backsim \vartriangle CFE,\)
\(\therefore \frac { DF } { EF }=\frac { BD } { CF },\)
\(\therefore \frac { 5x-6 } { 5x-\frac { 2x ^ { 2 } } { 3 } }=\frac { 6 } { x },\)
解得\(x=4\)或\(x=0\)（舍去），
\(\therefore CF=4,\)
\(\therefore BC=5x=20,\)
在\({ \rm{ R } }{ \rm{ t } }\vartriangle ABL\)中，\(\angle B{ \rm{ = } }{ \rm{ 6 } }{ \rm{ 0 } }{}^\circ\)，
\(\therefore AL=AB\cdot sin60{}^\circ =20\times \frac { \sqrt[] { 3 } } { 2 }=10\sqrt[] { 3 }\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle ABC } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }\times 20\times 10\sqrt[] { 3 }=100\sqrt[] { 3 },\)
在\({ \rm{ R } }{ \rm{ t } }\vartriangle BDH\)中，\(\angle B=60{}^\circ ,BD=3\)，
\(\therefore DH=\frac { \sqrt[] { 3 } } { 2 }BD=3\sqrt[] { 3 },\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle BDF } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }\times BF\cdot DH=\frac { 1 } { 2 }\times 16\)\(\times 3\sqrt[] { 3 }=24\sqrt[] { 3 }\)
\(\because \vartriangle BDF\backsim \vartriangle CFE,\)
\(\therefore \frac { S_{ \vartriangle BDF } } { S_{ \vartriangle CFE } }=\left ( { \frac { BD } { CF } } \right ) ^ { 2 } =\left ( { \frac { 3 } { 2 } } \right ) ^ { 2 } =\frac { 9 } { 4 },\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle CEF } =\frac { 4 } { 9 }S_{ \vartriangle BDF } =\frac { 32 } { 3 }\sqrt[] { 3 },\)
\(\because A,F\)为轴对称图形对应点的连线，\(DE\)为对称轴，
\(\therefore AD=DF,\vartriangle ADF\)为等腰三角形，
\(\therefore DE\bot AF,\)
\(\therefore\)四边形\(ADFE\)的面积\(=\frac { 1 } { 2 }DE\cdot AF\)，
\(\because\)四边形\(ADFE\)的面积\(=S_{ \vartriangle ABC } -S_{ \vartriangle BDF } -S_{ \vartriangle CEF } =100\sqrt[] { 3 }\)\(-24\sqrt[] { 3 }-\frac { 32 } { 3 }\sqrt[] { 3 }=\frac { 196 } { 3 }\sqrt[] { 3 }\)，
\(\therefore\)\(DE\cdot AF=2\times \frac { 196 } { 3 }\sqrt[] { 3 }=\frac { 392 } { 3 }\sqrt[] { 3 }\)．
故答案为：\(\frac { 392 } { 3 }\sqrt[] { 3 }\)．
【点睛】本题考查了等边三角形的性质，相似的判定及性质，折叠的性质，锐角三角函数等知识，解题关键是正确做出辅助线，难度较大，为中考常考题型．
